lines.t: Say no more of grace versus the law,
For truth walks deeper than the draw—
Grace and Law, two flames the same,
The heart of mercy in justice’s name.
Where grace is gone, lawless winds will rise,
But the faithful spirit sees through the lies.
Grace and the Law, hand in hand,
Heaven’s order across the land.
Grace is the breath the Law fulfills,
A holy mountain, a heart that stills.
The Law reflects the Spirit within,
A living mirror cleansed of sin.
Those who cry, “He’s in me, I in Him,”
And walk apart, grow dark and dim.
In that Day, the truth will stand,
Every deed weighed in His hand.
Not by word but by the way,
Love in action will light the day.
Grace and the Law, hand in hand,
Heaven’s order across the land.
Grace is the breath the Law fulfills,
A holy mountain, a heart that stills.
In harmony they rise and fall—
Grace and the Law, the crown of all.
[instrumental fade]
